content: ngrok free plan (2026): 1 GB/mo data, 20,000 HTTP req/mo, 5,000 TCP conn/mo, 10,000 logs+events/mo; rate 4,000 HTTP req/min, 100 TCP conn/min; up to 3 simultaneous endpoints, 3 concurrent agents, 1 development domain. Endpoints have no timeout and can stay online indefinitely. Since 2023 every free account gets ONE permanent static dev domain (name.ngrok-free.app / .ngrok-free.dev) permanently assigned to the account - it does NOT change on restart. So the 'random URL every boot' premise is obsolete: pin the dev domain and the webhook URL is stable forever.
